title: Honest extraction coverage, bounded acquired binaries, and the evidence-soundness patch for the integrator
problem: A scanned PDF page proved a phrase absent; acquired binaries' output was fully buffered with no memory ceiling; mission predicates judged a receipt's kept prefix as the whole value.
baseline: #201 head fe82005: found=false on scanned pages; subprocess.run(capture_output) then a length check; missions._field unwraps the prefix.

alternatives.name: Proposed: page coverage in document.text; RLIMIT_FSIZE/RLIMIT_AS limiter for catalog binaries; tri-state judge proposed as a patch to the missions owner
alternatives.description: Stdlib resource limits in a child of the existing isolated process; capabilities.run_isolated untouched; missions.py edited only by its owner.
disadvantages: Engine fix waits on the owner

alternatives.name: Bound output inside run_isolated for every caller
alternatives.description: Change the shared spawner to stream with a cap.
advantages: Covers run_cli, git and every other caller
disadvantages: Shared seam owned by others; larger blast radius
alternatives.revival_evidence: A second caller is shown to buffer an attacker-sized output

alternatives.name: OCR with Tesseract
alternatives.description: Read scanned pages instead of reporting them.
disadvantages: Not installed; installation is the founder's; needs its own oracle

alternatives.name: Fail-closed binary licenses now
disadvantages: 442 of 707 binaries held on this body, shasum among them

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Forbidden-clause checks pass on scanned PDFs; a large output can exhaust the body's memory; long-output missions close falsely.

roles.position: The directive's priority zero: no closure on evidence not inspected.
material_concerns: The generic engine fix is not in this PR

roles.position: Smallest sound change at each seam; no new evidence plane; Boolean interface kept.

pass_1.intended_outcome: No mission closes, and no capability qualifies, on evidence it did not fully read; acquired binaries cannot exhaust the body.

advantages.statement: Completeness becomes a declared property any capability can report
advantages.amplified_value: The engine patch honours complete: false generically, so future readers inherit it

disadvantages.statement: Blank pages are indistinguishable from scans
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Reported as unread; pdfimages -list recorded as the discriminator
Output ceiling still enforced; stated limit

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the limiter (signals, spool files), the coverage claim (forged completeness), and the patch (forged wrappers, legacy receipts, refusal watches).

new_weaknesses.statement: Python ignores SIGXFSZ and exec inherits it, so the binary saw EFBIG instead of dying
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Limiter restores SIG_DFL; size check refuses at the ceiling either way

new_weaknesses.statement: A capability dict shaped like a truncation wrapper could be unwrapped
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Only the exact wrapper with length > len(prefix) is unwrapped (tested)
A list of exactly 1000 items is treated as possibly cut
